headlines.text: Rewind to 2025, when Adam Page vs. Kyle Fletcher met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 8.67 ? a war that left everything in the ring. Page hit a Buckshot Lariat off the apron to defeat Fletcher after a grueling half-hour semifinal, advancing to face Ospreay at Double or Nothing.
Rewind to 2025, when Miyu Yamashita stepped back through the curtain after a long-awaited absence after just under 3 years away, appearing on Dynamite.
Looking back to 2025, when Dynamite stood out as one of AEW's best-received shows of the year, rated 8.15.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2025: Nick Wayne vs. Jay Lethal clashed for the ROH World TV Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.34.
